before_action.text: 「患者久宇舞弥，术式与影像核对完毕。静脉重建材料已确认。」
before_action.text_en: “Patient: Maiya Hisau. Procedure and imaging verified. Venous reconstruction material confirmed.”

before_action.text: 「今天不是单纯切除。切除边界和重建路线，一开始就要在同一张图上。」
before_action.text_en: “This is more than a resection. We need the resection margins and reconstruction route on the same map from the start.”

before_action.text: 「第一助手就位。需要调整牵引或视角，直接告诉我。」
before_action.text_en: “First assistant in position. Tell me whenever you need traction or a change of view.”

after_resolution.text: 「开腹完成，牵开器固定。术野可以展开。」
after_resolution.text_en: “Abdominal entry complete. Retractors secured. The field is ready.”

before_action.text: 「先做系统探查，再充分游离十二指肠。我要看到实际病灶关系。」
before_action.text_en: “Systematic exploration first, then adequate duodenal mobilization. I want the actual relationships in view.”

before_action.text: 「后方界面由我协助牵开，主刀可以集中探查。」
before_action.text_en: “I will maintain posterior exposure so the lead surgeon can focus on exploration.”

before_action.text: 「影像所见和目前触及的界面基本一致。深部还有一段需要暴露。」
before_action.text_en: “The visible planes broadly match the imaging. We still need to expose the deeper portion.”

after_resolution.text: 「Kocher 游离完成，后方界面已开放。」
after_resolution.text_en: “Kocher mobilization complete. The posterior plane is exposed.”

before_action.text: 「确认肝门结构。胆道、动脉和静脉的关系不能靠印象判断。」
before_action.text_en: “Identify the hilar anatomy. We cannot rely on assumptions about the bile duct, artery, or vein.”

before_action.text: 「肝门区牵引稳定，解剖层次清楚。」
before_action.text_en: “Hilar retraction is stable. The anatomy is well defined.”

before_action.text: 「细分离器械和血管带备妥。」
before_action.text_en: “Fine dissection instruments and vessel loops are ready.”

after_resolution.text: 「胆道及邻近血管关系已经分清，下一步可以打开网膜囊。」
after_resolution.text_en: “The biliary and adjacent vascular anatomy is defined. We can proceed to the lesser sac.”

before_action.text: 「沿胰颈后方找到静脉轴，先核对上下游，再谈切除长度。」
before_action.text_en: “Identify the venous axis behind the pancreatic neck. Confirm both ends before deciding the resection length.”

before_action.text: 「静脉两端的暴露角度已经调整。」
before_action.text_en: “Exposure has been adjusted at both ends of the vein.”

before_action.text: 「术前血管重建图已调到对照位置。」
before_action.text_en: “The preoperative vascular reconstruction map is on display for comparison.”

after_resolution.text: 「PV/SMV 两端可辨，预定间置段的位置清楚了。」
after_resolution.text_en: “Both ends of the PV/SMV segment are identifiable. The planned interposition site is clear.”

before_action.text: 「现在决定暴露到什么程度。之后进入深处分离，就不能频繁换计划。」
before_action.text_en: “We decide the extent of exposure now. Once deep dissection begins, frequent changes of plan are costly.”

before_action.text: 「预控器械可以配合标准或扩展暴露，请主刀选择。」
before_action.text_en: “Control instruments are ready for either standard or extended exposure. Your choice.”

before_action.text: 「标准血管预控和扩展暴露两套器械都备好了。」
before_action.text_en: “Both standard vascular-control and extended-exposure instruments are ready.”

after_resolution.text: 「血管控制计划确认，策略记录完成。」
after_resolution.text_en: “The vascular-control plan is confirmed and recorded.”

before_action.text: 「这段静脉必须分离得足够清楚，但多剥一毫米也没有价值。」
before_action.text_en: “We need a fully defined venous segment, but an extra millimeter of needless dissection gains us nothing.”

before_action.text: 「近端控制与对侧牵引就位，主刀可开始精细分离。」
before_action.text_en: “Proximal control and contralateral traction are ready. Fine dissection may begin.”

before_action.text: 「无损伤血管夹、细线与冲洗准备完毕。」
before_action.text_en: “Atraumatic clamps, fine sutures, and irrigation are ready.”

after_resolution.text: 「静脉预控稳定，切除段已能独立辨认。」
after_resolution.text_en: “Venous control is stable, and the planned resection segment is clearly defined.”

after_resolution.text: 「血管预控核对完成。」
after_resolution.text_en: “Vascular control verified.”

precision_failed.text: 「等一下，静脉外膜的层次偏了。先停住，重建视野。」
precision_failed.text_en: “Hold. We have drifted off the venous adventitial plane. Pause and restore the view.”

before_action.text: 「先规划每个断端。切掉之后，重建不能留下靠猜的位置。」
before_action.text_en: “Plan each division point now. Once the specimen is out, reconstruction must not depend on guesswork.”

before_action.text: 「断端方向已标记，重建顺序已核对。」
before_action.text_en: “Stump orientation is marked and reconstruction order checked.”

before_action.text: 「断端标记、保护材料和标本袋已备齐。」
before_action.text_en: “Stump markers, protective materials, and the specimen bag are ready.”

after_resolution.text: 「胆道和胃肠断端已按计划准备，可以进入深部切除。」
after_resolution.text_en: “Biliary and gastrointestinal division points are prepared as planned. Deep resection can proceed.”

before_action.text: 「胰颈之后是钩突。贴近血管的这一层，视野比速度重要。」
before_action.text_en: “After the pancreatic neck comes the uncinate process. At the vascular interface, vision matters more than speed.”

before_action.text: 「钩突深部已有清晰牵引，关键血管在视野内。」
before_action.text_en: “The deep uncinate plane is under clear traction, with the key vessels visible.”

before_action.text: 「循环参数可维持，目前允许继续精细分离。」
before_action.text_en: “Hemodynamics remain supportable. Fine dissection can continue.”

after_resolution.text: 「胰颈及钩突界面完成，肿瘤连同静脉受累段已具备整块切除条件。」
after_resolution.text_en: “The pancreatic neck and uncinate plane are complete. The tumor and involved vein are ready for en bloc resection.”

precision_failed.text: 「钩突深部的分离点没有完全显露，继续会失去参照。」
precision_failed.text_en: “The deep uncinate dissection point is not fully exposed. Continuing would cost us our reference.”

before_action.text: 「按既定边界一并取出，不能为了省一步而拆开病灶与静脉界面。」
before_action.text_en: “Remove the specimen within the planned boundaries. We cannot split the tumor from the venous interface merely to save a step.”

before_action.text: 「标本边界与血管夹位置再次确认，准备整块切除。」
before_action.text_en: “Specimen margins and clamp positions reconfirmed. Ready for en bloc resection.”

before_action.text: 「血管阻断窗口已经开始。请明确报告预计恢复血流的时间。」
before_action.text_en: “The vascular-clamp window has begun. Please keep us informed of the expected time to reperfusion.”

after_resolution.text: 「整块标本已移出。两端静脉断口保护完成，立即转入重建。」
after_resolution.text_en: “The en bloc specimen is out. Both venous ends are protected. Moving immediately to reconstruction.”

after_resolution.text: 「标本交接完成，准备重建。」
after_resolution.text_en: “Specimen handed off. Preparing reconstruction.”

precision_failed.text: 「整块切除的静脉边界没对齐。先核对夹持位置。」
precision_failed.text_en: “The venous boundary of the en bloc resection is misaligned. Recheck the clamp positions.”

before_action.text: 「缺损已经确定。确认长度、方向、张力，吻合时才有余地。」
before_action.text_en: “Now the defect is defined. Confirm length, orientation, and tension so we have room to work during anastomosis.”

before_action.text: 「移植物支持到位，可以核对两端距离。」
before_action.text_en: “The graft is supported and ready for end-to-end measurements.”

before_action.text: 「移植物与方向标记已送入无菌台。」
before_action.text_en: “The graft and orientation marks are on the sterile field.”

after_resolution.text: 「移植物尺寸与走行确认完毕，可开始尾端吻合。」
after_resolution.text_en: “Graft dimensions and course confirmed. Ready for the caudal anastomosis.”

before_action.text: 「先处理 SMV 端。缝合视线要始终看得到后壁。」
before_action.text_en: “We start at the SMV end. Keep the posterior wall continuously visible during suturing.”

before_action.text: 「SMV 端已摆正，后壁可以连续观察。」
before_action.text_en: “The SMV end is aligned. The posterior wall remains visible.”

before_action.text: 「血管缝线、放大镜视野和持续湿润已经准备好。」
before_action.text_en: “Vascular sutures, magnified view, and continuous moistening are ready.”

after_resolution.text: 「尾端吻合完成。头端仍待完成，门静脉血流尚未恢复。」
after_resolution.text_en: “The caudal anastomosis is complete. The cranial end remains open; portal flow has not yet been restored.”

after_resolution.text: 「尾端完成，转向头端。」
after_resolution.text_en: “Caudal end complete. Moving to the cranial end.”

precision_failed.text: 「尾端吻合的后壁针距不均，先检查再继续。」
precision_failed.text_en: “The caudal posterior-wall suture spacing is uneven. Check it before proceeding.”

before_action.text: 「最后一圈之前再看轴向。复灌以后，再纠正扭曲就迟了。」
before_action.text_en: “Check the graft axis before the final stitches. Correcting a twist after reperfusion would be too late.”

before_action.text: 「头端张力、轴向与放夹顺序已经核对。」
before_action.text_en: “Cranial tension, axis, and clamp-release sequence are verified.”

before_action.text: 「准备配合放夹与循环监测。请提前报复灌时点。」
before_action.text_en: “Ready to coordinate clamp release and hemodynamic monitoring. Call out before reperfusion.”

after_resolution.text: 「头端吻合与逐步复灌完成，移植物走行及血流已初步确认。」
after_resolution.text_en: “The cranial anastomosis and controlled reperfusion are complete. Graft course and flow have passed the initial check.”

after_resolution.text: 「复灌后初步血流检查通过。」
after_resolution.text_en: “Initial flow check passed after reperfusion.”

precision_failed.text: 「头端吻合的轴向不够理想。复灌前必须重新确认。」
precision_failed.text_en: “The cranial anastomosis is not aligned well enough. We must reassess it before reperfusion.”

before_action.text: 「血流恢复不是终点。现在回到三个消化道重建断端。」
before_action.text_en: “Restoring flow is not the finish line. We now return to the three digestive reconstruction sites.”

before_action.text: 「静脉重建区保持保护，准备转向消化道断端。」
before_action.text_en: “The venous reconstruction remains protected as we turn to the digestive stumps.”

before_action.text: 「胰管、胆管和空肠断端保护完整，重建器械已更新。」
before_action.text_en: “Pancreatic, biliary, and jejunal ends remain protected. Reconstruction instruments are set.”

after_resolution.text: 「静脉段阶段已交接，消化道重建准备完成。」
after_resolution.text_en: “The venous phase is handed over. Digestive reconstruction is ready.”

before_action.text: 「先看胰管口径和断面质量。这个吻合允许慢，不允许含糊。」
before_action.text_en: “Assess the duct diameter and cut-surface quality first. We can be slow here, but we cannot be imprecise.”

before_action.text: 「胰管与空肠壁已对位，可以开始精细吻合。」
before_action.text_en: “The pancreatic duct and jejunal wall are aligned for fine anastomosis.”

before_action.text: 「胰管定位和精细缝合器械就位。」
before_action.text_en: “Duct alignment and fine anastomotic instruments are in place.”

after_resolution.text: 「胰肠吻合完成，局部张力和吻合口形态已检查。」
after_resolution.text_en: “Pancreaticojejunostomy is complete. Local tension and anastomotic geometry have been checked.”

after_resolution.text: 「吻合口形态复核完成。」
after_resolution.text_en: “Anastomotic geometry verified.”

precision_failed.text: 「胰管与肠壁的对位偏了，不能直接把这一针收紧。」
precision_failed.text_en: “The pancreatic duct and jejunal wall are slightly misaligned. Do not tighten that stitch yet.”

before_action.text: 「确认胆管壁与肠管方向。不要让前一个吻合牵扯这里的角度。」
before_action.text_en: “Check the bile duct wall and bowel orientation. The previous anastomosis must not distort this one.”

before_action.text: 「胆管与肠袢位置稳定，吻合视野清楚。」
before_action.text_en: “The bile duct and bowel limb are stable, with a clear anastomotic field.”

before_action.text: 「吻合口周围清洁，细线和冲洗备妥。」
before_action.text_en: “The site is clean. Fine sutures and irrigation are ready.”

after_resolution.text: 「胆肠吻合完成，管腔通畅及张力检查通过。」
after_resolution.text_en: “Hepaticojejunostomy is complete. Patency and tension checks passed.”

precision_failed.text: 「胆肠吻合的边缘张力不一致，先把牵引调回来。」
precision_failed.text_en: “Tension along the hepaticojejunostomy edge is uneven. Readjust the traction first.”

before_action.text: 「重建的最后一处。确认肠袢没有扭转，再决定吻合位置。」
before_action.text_en: “The last reconstruction. Confirm that the bowel limb has no twist before choosing the anastomotic site.”

before_action.text: 「肠袢扭转检查完成，下一吻合位已标定。」
before_action.text_en: “The bowel limb has been checked for twisting; the anastomotic site is marked.”

before_action.text: 「输入与输出肠袢方向已重新核对。」
before_action.text_en: “The afferent and efferent limbs have been rechecked for orientation.”

after_resolution.text: 「胃肠吻合完成。三处消化道重建均已建立。」
after_resolution.text_en: “Gastrojejunostomy is complete. All three digestive anastomoses are in place.”

precision_failed.text: 「胃肠吻合口的方向出现偏差。先确认肠袢没有旋转。」
precision_failed.text_en: “The gastrojejunostomy orientation has shifted. Check the bowel limb for rotation.”

before_action.text: 「现在按计划逐项核对血流和吻合口。不能因为离结束很近就省略确认。」
before_action.text_en: “Now we check flow and every anastomosis against the plan. Being close to the finish is no reason to skip verification.”

before_action.text: 「最终复核清单在手，血流与三处吻合口逐项核对。」
before_action.text_en: “Final checklist ready. Reviewing graft flow and all three anastomoses item by item.”

before_action.text: 「全程循环记录已汇总，等待最后的复核结果。」
before_action.text_en: “The hemodynamic record is consolidated. Awaiting the final review.”

after_resolution.text: 「最终复核记录完毕，允许进入清点与关闭流程。」
after_resolution.text_en: “Final verification documented. Cleared for counts and closure.”

after_resolution.text: 「最终复核通过，准备关闭。」
after_resolution.text_en: “Final review passed. Preparing closure.”

before_action.text: 「器械和纱布清点开始。引流与关闭材料齐备。」
before_action.text_en: “Instrument and sponge counts are beginning. Drains and closure materials are ready.”

before_action.text: 「确认所有记录一致，再关腹。」
before_action.text_en: “Match every record before abdominal closure.”

before_action.text: 「清点一致后可以关闭，我配合主刀完成收尾。」
before_action.text_en: “We can close once counts agree. I will assist the lead surgeon through the finish.”

after_resolution.text: 「最终清点一致，腹壁关闭完成。手术记录进入结算。」
after_resolution.text_en: “Final counts reconcile. Abdominal closure is complete. The case is ready for settlement.”
